# Packages added on top of the course AMI's ~/dl-venv, which already ships a
# CUDA build of torch/torchvision. Install with:
#
#     source ~/dl-venv/bin/activate
#     pip install -r env/requirements.txt
#
# Do NOT pip install torch here: that would pull a CPU wheel over the AMI's
# working CUDA build.
#
# After the environment passes scripts/check_env.py, freeze the exact
# versions that were verified on the GPU:
#
#     pip freeze > env/tested-requirements.txt
#
# That frozen file, not this one, is the reproducibility record.
